“Then He said to them, ‘The Kingdom of God is not a matter of talk but of power.’ — 1 Cor 4:20  

The world measures authority by titles; the Kingdom moves by the unseen hand of the Almighty. Every decision you face today is an invitation to submit to that divine power, not merely to human opinion.  

What Kingdom‑power are you choosing to walk in right now?

“Your kingdom come, your will be done, on earth as it is in heaven.” — Matt 6:10  
The Kingdom isn’t a future hope; it’s a present authority. When we submit every decision to Christ’s rule, the world rearranges itself to obey His agenda.  

What kingdom‑level step will you take today to let God’s will dominate? ____.
